summary: Raise the HVAC Repair Maximize Clicks CPC ceiling from $25.00 to $65.00. 1 operation. One campaign, one variable.
campaign_name: Search | NonBrand | HVAC Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
why_65_and_not_30: Google Keyword Planner top-of-page bid estimate for the live keyword `hvac repair near me`, measured against the campaign's own 75-target Central Maryland geo: LOW $49.47, HIGH $126.18. The current $25.00 ceiling sits BELOW Google's own LOW estimate.
`ac repair near me` estimates LOW $38.98 / HIGH $118.07 - also above $25.00.
HVAC Repair's August average CPC when uncapped was $106.27 and it produced 4 of the account's conversions.
Of the 13 clicks that have ever converted in this account, 12 cost more than every ceiling now in place; the cheapest converting click above $25 was $59.44.
$65.00 sits between Google's LOW and HIGH top-of-page estimates - deliberately mid-band, not a return to uncapped bidding.
A +20% step to $30.00 is rejected: it remains below the LOW estimate and would almost certainly reproduce the current zero-delivery result while consuming a test cycle.

HARD_GATE: DO NOT EXECUTE until: (1) AMB-0915-LP-1 is deployed, (2) the attribution probe returns 24/24, and (3) AMB-0915-CONV-1 is executed or a reliable manual qualified-lead verification path is agreed. Raising a bid while form attribution is broken buys traffic that cannot be measured.
economic_warning: Measured paid-search CPQL over the last 90 settled days is $827.45 upper bound ($8,274.54 spend / 10 WhatConverts quotable=Yes paid-search leads). Even the most generous correction for click-id loss leaves it near $394. Every provisional guardrail is $150-$280. This test is therefore a DELIVERY and MEASUREMENT test - does volume return and can we see it - not a profitability claim. If volume returns at a CPQL still far above guardrail, the correct next move is landing-page conversion rate, not more bid.
risk: MEDIUM. Bounded by the $78.95 daily budget and the $250 stop-loss.
